method: Use all30 actual A4500 cases per copy count. Normalize each actual complete round by its recorded positive full-update count. Separate recorded total-minus-timed-round cost; add nine additional copies of normalized warmup cost for ten-update warmups; extrapolate70reference+70candidate full updates from worst observed seconds per update, double the combined cost and add900seconds. This is a conservative planning estimate, not a measured new-combination runtime.
